privacy.title: Privacy Policy

section1.title: 1. Introduction
section1.content: Welcome to Oglasnik. We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This privacy policy will inform you about how we look after your personal data when you visit our website and tell you about your privacy rights and how the law protects you.

section2.title: 2. Information We Collect
section2.intro: We may collect, use, store and transfer different kinds of personal data about you:
section2.item1: Identity Data: name, username or similar identifier
section2.item2: Contact Data: email address and telephone numbers
section2.item3: Technical Data: internet protocol (IP) address, browser type and version
section2.item4: Usage Data: information about how you use our website and services

section3.title: 3. How We Use Your Information
section3.content: We will only use your personal data when the law allows us to. Most commonly, we will use your personal data to provide services to you, to improve our website and services, and to communicate with you about updates, offers, and news related to our services.

section4.title: 4. Data Security
section4.content: We have put in place appropriate security measures to prevent your personal data from being accidentally lost, used or accessed in an unauthorized way, altered or disclosed. We limit access to your personal data to those employees, agents, contractors and other third parties who have a business need to know.

section5.title: 5. Your Legal Rights
section5.content: Under certain circumstances, you have rights under data protection laws in relation to your personal data, including the right to request access, correction, erasure, restriction, transfer, or to object to processing. If you wish to exercise any of these rights, please contact us.

section6.title: 6. Contact Us
section6.content: If you have any questions about this privacy policy or our privacy practices, please contact us using the contact information provided below.
